archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) mixed with Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury structural feel)

rules.headings: Tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter), font-medium to font-bold.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. High contrast. B&W premium SaaS aesthetic.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento grids with asymmetry for marketing. Strict dense grids for admin dashboard.

components.buttons: Sharp corners or very slight rounding (rounded-md max). High contrast (white on black, or black on white). hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform.
components.cards: 1px subtle borders. Glassmorphism only for sticky headers (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-black/60). Inner cards should use pure flat colors.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. Dark mode inputs: bg-[#121212] border-white/10. Light mode inputs: bg-white border-black/10.
components.navbar: Fixed z-50. Starts transparent. On scroll: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/50 (dark section) or bg-white/70 (light section).
components.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button')

hero.features: Dark gradient background, Typing animation headline ('Join the most action-oriented community'), Interactive 3D sphere (React Three Fiber + Drei).
hero.cta: Primary button 'Apply Now' (white text on white/10 bg with glowing hover, or solid white with black text).

community_section.layout: Left: 2 Cards (Student / Founder). Right: Editorial typography text explaining the divide.
community_section.cards_instruction: Use images provided in media section for backgrounds of these cards.

problem_section.layout: Split layout. Students vs Founders. Thin vertical divider border-white/10.

solution_section.layout: Structured bento grid cards explaining the system.

social_proof.layout: Image grid of real networking events, overlaid with big stats: '500+ Members', '20+ Events'.

student_page.form_card: Light gradient form card (bg-white/5 border-white/10). Fields: Name, College, Course, Email.
student_page.flow: Apply -> OTP -> Google Drive Link -> Submit.
student_page.benefits: Grid showing Internships, Events, Hackathons, Bootcamps.

business_page.form_card: Slightly more structured/serious. Fields: Name, Company, Role, Stage, Email.

admin_dashboard.layout: Left sidebar (dark bg-[#0A0A0A]), Right dashboard content (light bg-[#FAFAFA]).
admin_dashboard.features: Stats overview, Users table (Students/Business tabs), Approve/Reject actions, Bulk email interface.
admin_dashboard.ui_components: Shadcn tables, badges (pending/approved), dialogs for user details.

tech_stack.file_type: jsx and js ONLY. Do not use tsx.

hero_background.description: Premium black and white abstract texture for the deep background layer

student_card_bg.description: Minimalist white architectural space for student representation card

founder_card_bg.description: Abstract 3D geometric shapes for founder representation card

social_proof_events.description: People mingling at a formal networking event

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use placeholder text or URLs. Use ONLY the media URLs provided in this JSON.
Ensure the hero has an interactive 3D sphere reacting to the mouse pointer.
In the Admin Dashboard, the left sidebar MUST be dark, and the right main area MUST be light.
Ensure all buttons, form inputs, links, and key UI components have a data-testid attribute.
Typography: Use Cabinet Grotesk for Headings, Inter for Body. Apply tight tracking to headings.
Avoid generic 'SaaS blue' or purple gradients. Stick strictly to the premium black, white, and grayscale palette.
For the typing animation, utilize framer-motion or a simple react typing effect library.
